message: I have a friend who's the gloriously over-prepared type. She has go-bags for every family member, stocked with snacks, water, and even a deck of cards for entertainment. I used to chuckle at her, but after a recent storm knocked out our power, I found myself wishing I had her foresight. It reminded me that a little preparation can make a big difference in keeping our families comfortable and calm. What’s your favorite tip for staying ready, even when life gets a little unpredictable? 😊
